text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright! This is it!
This is the feeeeling!!

As soon as the race was over, without even caring about the result,
Vodka was stomping repeatedly on the dirt.

She must have gained what she truly desired. And that fact...
might be even greater than winning consecutive titles in the same G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I did it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Back-to-back Yasuda Kinen victories?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait. If I recall, last year...
Yeah, that's right, winning last year too...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, for real!
Winning back-to-back, aren't I just the coolest!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And the fact that you don't even realize it yourself
is the best part!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOAAAH,
Hey fans! Back-to-back champ right here!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And I didn't even realize itttt!
(UOOOOOOOOH!!)

I don't know what kind of statement she's making,
but since it's a celebratory occasion, maybe it's fine.

And more important than winning was the dash power she aimed to gain.
When I asked her about it—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I've got it down. Lower my posture,
quicken each stride, and ride the gale in one swift burst."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now. As long as I have this running style,
I can shine brighter than anyone, anytime, anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Not just the mile, but any distance.
choice_data_list: How about Medium and Long distances, then?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, these legs are ready to roll.
They're gonna be one hell of a weapon.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just think about it.
It's a burst of speed sharp enough
to blow right past milers boasting about their pace, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Against an opponent who is exhausted and flagging on the final stretch of a medium-to-long distance race, the effect is doubled.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Forget back-to-back Yasuda Kinen wins.
I don't feel like losing to anyone anymore.
She glares fearlessly at the sky. A shiver ran down my spine at her sharp gaze.

Without a doubt, Vodka had perfected herself
and reached a new pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can stand proudly before any formidable rival.
Even before her.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Trainer. Which GⅠ do you think Scarlet will set her sights on this coming autumn?"
Thinking about her personality: she loves being in the spotlight, loves being number one, and considering her versatile running style that handles any distance—
choice_data_list: It'd be the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I guess.
It'd be the Tenno Sho (Autumn), right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "I knew it. Man, we're totally on the same wavelength, you and me."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then that'll be our
Twinkle Series showdown.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let me run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
I want to claim the ultimate glory looking cooler than ever.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, that's my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No matter how prestigious the race is,
there's nothin' to fear. And why? Because—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since the Derby,
this place has loved me, after all."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
See ya again, Tokyo Racecourse!
Give me another great tailwind next time, too!
